name: 25427 · Hedgesville, WV
findings: ZIP 25427 (Hedgesville) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25427 (Hedgesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 25427 (Hedgesville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
